newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 views on forex unlikely to change this week - MOF.
newsitem.headline: G7 views on forex unlikely to change this week - MOF.

text.p: Views on foreign exchange markets agreed at a meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations in Berlin in February are likely to remain unchanged at their meeting in Washington this weekend, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.

Mitsuzuka said the G7 members confirmed at the Berlin meeting that excessive weakness of the yen as well as excessive strength of the yen was unfavourable, and that they would deal with such movements as appropriate.
"I don't think the overall analysis of the situation will change during the forthcoming G7 meeting," he said.
